hints.title: Exact Difference Decomposition
hints.text: Substrings with exactly k consonants and all 5 vowels can be expressed as atLeast(k) - atLeast(k + 1).

hints.title: At Least K Sliding Window
hints.text: Maintain counts for vowels 'a', 'e', 'i', 'o', 'u' and a running consonant count. Expand right until all 5 vowels are present and consonants >= target.

hints.title: Suffix Extension Addition
hints.text: When valid, all substrings ending from right through n - 1 are also valid. Add n - right to the running count and shrink left.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Both pointers move monotonically from 0 to n in O(n) total operations.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: O(n^2) substring inspection is impossible for n up to 2 * 10^5.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Reduces exact count query to two atLeast sliding windows.
